_comment: English for the fixed vocabulary of the CDC travel medicine open data (pipeline/travelmed.py, docs/TRAVELMED.md). Keys are the Chinese text after NFKC. A string missing here is shown in Chinese (en = zh) and logged as a warning.

advice.中東呼吸道冠狀病毒可能會透過駱駝傳染,在當地應避免接觸或騎乘駱駝、生飲駝奶: MERS coronavirus can spread through camels: avoid touching or riding camels and drinking raw camel milk.
advice.伊波拉病毒大多由染病的野生動物感染人類,在當地應避免接觸蝙蝠、靈長類動物及其屍體: Ebola is mostly passed to people from infected wild animals: avoid bats, primates and their carcasses, and avoid contact with the body fluids of infected people.
advice.使用河水、湖水洗澡或洗衣,建議添加氯錠消毒,或在乾淨容器至少儲放2天再使用: If you wash or do laundry with river or lake water, add chlorine tablets, or keep the water in a clean container for at least 2 days before using it.
advice.在當地應勤用肥皂洗手,若無法取得肥皂及水源,建議應使用至少含60%酒精成份的乾洗: Wash your hands often with soap; if soap and water are not available, use a hand sanitiser with at least 60% alcohol.
advice.在當地應避免逗弄、餵食哺乳動物,並避免至可能有蝙蝠的洞窟,以免感染狂犬病: Do not tease or feed mammals, and stay out of caves that may house bats, to avoid rabies.
advice.如不慎碰觸淡水,請立即用酒精和乾毛巾大力擦拭皮膚,減低感染風險: If your skin touches fresh water, rub it hard with alcohol and a dry towel straight away to lower the risk of infection.
advice.如有任何疑似症狀,應及時就醫,並告知旅遊史、高風險場域暴露史與接觸史: If you have any suspicious symptoms, see a doctor promptly and tell them your travel history, high-risk exposures and contacts.
advice.如遭蜱蟲叮咬,可以鑷子夾住蜱蟲前半部,垂直皮膚表面緩慢向上拔除,如無適當工具,建: If a tick bites you, grip its front end with tweezers and pull it slowly straight out of the skin; without proper tools, see a doctor so the mouthparts do not break off in the bite and cause infection.
advice.如需接觸動物時,應採取適當防護措施,如戴手套、口罩及工作服等,尤其是處理生病的動: If you must handle animals, wear protection such as gloves, a mask and work clothes, especially with sick animals; afterwards wash your hands and any other exposed skin with soap.
advice.戶外活動時,穿著淺色長袖衣褲、包鞋及長襪,儘量減少裸露部位: Outdoors, wear light-coloured long sleeves and trousers, closed shoes and socks, and keep as little skin exposed as possible.
advice.拉薩熱大多由染病的囓齒類動物感染人類,在當地應避免接觸囓齒類動物及其屍體,並避免: Lassa fever is mostly passed to people from infected rodents: avoid rodents and their carcasses, and avoid contact with the body fluids of infected people.
advice.新型A型流感大多由染病的禽類感染人類,在當地應避免出入有活禽的傳統市場、養殖場、: Novel influenza A is mostly passed to people from infected poultry: stay away from live-poultry markets, farms and bird parks, and avoid birds, their droppings and carcasses.
advice.茲卡病毒可由斑蚊叮咬傳播,一般旅客感染症狀較輕微,但孕婦感染可能導致胎兒小頭畸形: Zika is spread by Aedes mosquitoes. Most travellers have mild symptoms, but infection in pregnancy can cause microcephaly or death of the baby. Besides the measures above, pregnant women should postpone non-essential travel to areas at risk; pregnant women and those planning a pregnancy who must go should consult a doctor first and avoid mosquito bites throughout the stay.
advice.蜱媒腦炎是一種由蜱蟲傳播的疾病,蜱蟲多活動於森林、草原等有樹木、灌木或草地的地方: Tick-borne encephalitis is spread by ticks, which live in forests, grassland and places with trees, bushes or grass: take extra care against bites when you go there.
advice.選擇有空調、紗窗的旅館,或懸掛蚊帳(確認無破洞),必要時噴灑環境用殺蟲或防蚊劑: Choose accommodation with air conditioning or window screens, or sleep under a mosquito net without holes; spray insecticide or repellent in the room if needed.
advice.選擇衛生條件良好的用餐地點,如規模較大的飯店、沒有蟑螂蚊蠅的餐廳: Eat where hygiene is good, such as larger hotels and restaurants without cockroaches or flies.
advice.避免接觸河流、湖泊、池塘等淡水水域: Avoid contact with fresh water such as rivers, lakes and ponds.
advice.避免接觸流行地區蝙蝠或豬隻,及其他有可能感染的動物: Avoid bats, pigs and other animals that may be infected in affected areas.
advice.避免食用流行地區可能受感染蝙蝠尿液或唾液污染的水果或椰棗、樹汁等: In affected areas, do not eat fruit, dates or tree sap that may be contaminated with bat urine or saliva.
advice.降低人畜共通傳播風險: Reduce the risk of catching infections from animals.
advice.降低人際間傳播風險: Reduce the risk of person-to-person spread.
advice.養成良好的衛生習慣,如勤洗手(尤其是接觸動物後)及食用清洗乾淨之水果: Keep good hygiene: wash your hands often (especially after touching animals) and eat only well-washed fruit.
advice.馬堡病毒出血熱大多由染病的野生動物感染人類,在當地應避免接觸蝙蝠、靈長類動物及其: Marburg virus disease is mostly passed to people from infected wild animals: avoid bats, primates and their carcasses, and avoid contact with the body fluids of infected people.

places._comment: CDC country names (國名(中), or the web page's name) the name matcher cannot place: ISO alpha-2, {"sub": parent ISO} for a part of a country with its own prescription, or null to skip. A web page named here wins over another page matched by name for the same country (CDC has both 中國大陸 and the newer 中國大陸(不含港澳)).
